tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (14.2:1).

tokens.name: purple-deep
tokens.usage: Primary brand, show headers, premium features. Used as text on `.view-all:hover`, `.episode-category`. 10.6:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: purple-medium
tokens.usage: Purple Tints: #7c3aed (medium), #a78bfa (light), #e9d5ff (subtle). Used as text on `.view-all`, `.footer-links a:hover`. 5.5:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: purple-subtle
tokens.usage: Purple Tints: #7c3aed (medium), #a78bfa (light), #e9d5ff (subtle). Used as shadow/glow on `.search-box input:focus`.

tokens.name: white-warm
tokens.usage: Backgrounds, content areas, clean reading surface.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Neutrals: #1e293b (dark text), #64748b (secondary), #f1f5f9 (borders). Used as text on `body`, `.stat-value`, `.section-header h2`. 14.2:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Neutrals: #1e293b (dark text), #64748b (secondary), #f1f5f9 (borders). Used as text on `.logo-text p`, `.search-icon`, `.stat-label`. 4.6:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: logo-icon-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.logo-icon::before`, `.play-overlay`, `.category-tag`; border on `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
